cases.explain: «малые дети» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Even young children despise me. If I arise, they speak against me.

cases.explain: «Близкие друзья» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: All my familiar friends abhor me. They whom I loved have turned against me.

cases.explain: «железным резцом» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: That with an iron pen and lead they were engraved in the rock forever!
